records.method: Current reader visually inspected all new pages in four-page contact sheets from pdftoppm -scale-to 1800 -png; physical p.60 decision diagram rotated -90 degrees and separately inspected. Earlier process-chapter reading retained with original attribution.

review_blocks.observations: Cover, release 1.22 revision 4567, revision log and TOC, introduction/reader guide. Revision log includes later 2015 dates despite the April header. Reader-guide appendix names disagree with actual A/B TOC.

Spectral/non-spectral and lateral wave boundary descriptions; Neumann/wavecrest plots, offshore/landward/lateral flow options, cyclic diagram and MPI caveat, tides, river/point discharge and sediment boundaries; params.txt introduction.

Example params file; process switches/constants; grid sign, nx/ny and file layout; wave forcing overview and rotated decision diagram. Figure 4.1 uses wbctype/wavemodel while surrounding Kingsday input text uses instat.

Spectral parameter tables, JONSWAP directional-spread curves, SWAN/vardens matrix examples, time-series boundary formats, FILELIST and LOCLIST nesting. Energy interpolation and identical time discretization constraints are explicit.

Flow/tide tables and corner ordering, initial water level, dissipation, friction/viscosity, wind, sediment fractions/layers, morphology and non-erodible thickness. Physical p.73 forbids three tidal signals but p.74 table lists 0,1,2,3,4. p.77 bedfriccoef default is 0.003.

Vegetation sections and map indices; discharge signs and grid-orifice figure; drifters and ship geometry/track examples; output switches and types. Ship-motion compute_motion is described as not implemented.

Output-variable tables through water/bed fields, global/mean/point/runup examples, timing files and precedence, Fortran dumps/netCDF dimensions, CFL and tstop. Several output units/labels are source claims requiring code verification.
Six bibliography pages and a blank numbered page.

Advanced tables: wave/roller/wci, flow and sediment numerics, prescribed bathymetry, groundwater, nonhydro solver, Coriolis, MPI, projection. Nonhydro solver table uses tridiag and maxit 30, unlike legacy report recommendations/defaults.
Appendix B finite-volume staggered control volumes, wave-action B.1-B.3, mass/momentum B.4-B.11 and leapfrog schematic; groundwater infiltration and connectedness B.12-B.23.

Groundwater matrix/iterative conductivity B.24-B.28; sediment B.29-B.36; two bottom-update alternatives, avalanching and layer mass/split/merge B.37-B.43; boundary record/timestep and E_/q_ file flow.

Nonhydro B.44-B.67: global/local continuity, minmod flux correction, horizontal momentum/pressure split, vertical predictor/corrector and bottom kinematics. Final page 141 is footer 139 of 141; physical numbering used.

limitations: Full PDF page coverage combines prior and current observations; prior pages have no saved per-page image hashes. No new claim is made for unread DOCX renderings.

review_blocks.observations: Cover/metadata (138 printed pages), blank pages, three-page TOC, introduction and release 1.22 revision 4567 statement. Physical total is 145; footer sequence begins p.5 as 1 of 141.
Wave boundary types using wbctype, Neumann/wavecrest plots, flow boundary options, tidal and discharge/sediment conditions, separate cyclic section and plot; general input setup.
Params example, process switches, grid/bathy layout, wave input overview and rotated decision diagram. Repeated table A.1 labels occur in chapter 4.
Spectral table includes nspr/oldnyq/wbcversion; JONSWAP/spreading plot, SWAN/vardens examples, non-spectral time series, reuse and FILELIST.

LOCLIST interpolation; boundary tables (lateral table wrongly headed back), tide corner ordering and paulrevere, initial levels, wind, sediment fractions/layers. p.73 forbids three tidal signals; p.74 table gives 0-4.
Vegetation schematic/species files, discharge-orifice geometry/signs, drifters, ship geometry/track and force limitations; output option tables including globalvars/meanvars/pointvars.
Output variables and units, instantaneous/mean/point/runup selection, timing-file precedence, Fortran/netCDF formats and CFL/tstop. p.94 notes possible netCDF limitations for recent features.
Six bibliography pages.
Hands-on exercise instructions: Delfland storm, Kijkduin nourishments, Santa Rosa overwash, Yanchep reef. Read exercises only; did not download, execute or assert their numerical results.
Advanced wave/dissipation/roller/wci/friction/flow/sediment tables; quasi-3D sigma-layer options and morphology. p.110 bedfriccoef default 0.01 differs from Kingsday p.77 0.003.
Morphology/bed update, forced bathymetry example, groundwater, nonhydro/solver, physical constants, Coriolis, MPI and output projection tables.

Appendix C grid/control-volume diagrams, wave-action C.1-C.3, flow C.4-C.11 and leapfrog, groundwater C.12-C.26. p.125 visibly contains Error! Reference source not found. twice; these are original PDF errors.
Groundwater correction C.27-C.28, sediment C.29-C.36, bottom-update/layer mass C.37-C.43, boundary files and record/timestep interpolation.
Nonhydro C.44-C.67, continuity/minmod, horizontal pressure split/predictor/corrector, vertical momentum and bottom kinematics. Final physical page 145 is printed 141 of 141.
